sections.section_title: SYSCFG DMA CID secure control register (SYSCFG_SEC_AIDCR)
sections.text_helper: Section 16.1.25 "SYSCFG DMA CID secure control register (SYSCFG_SEC_AIDCR)" in chapter 16 (System configuration controller (SYSCFG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 824.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x070
Reset value: 0x0000 0001
Reset by system reset.
Bits 31:3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 2:0 DMACID_SEC[2:0]: Secure user accesses to the DMA present this programmed CID.
